parent_objective: implement and run no-ranking support-policy feasibility calibration panel
blocked_by: current scenario task family has not separated feasibility from actor weakness
controller-family ranking remains blocked until support calibration is audited
supersedes: direct controller-family comparison before support calibration

public_gates: M2313 must implement a support-policy diagnostic runner
M2313 must run 72 scenario specs x 3 support policies x 5 seed repeats = 1080 episodes
M2313 must write support labels and role support aggregates
M2313 must keep ranking_admissible false and winner_selected false
M2313 must not train replay PPO promote private holdout rank controllers or make paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat support policies as deployable candidates
do not compare support policies as winners

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: creates closed-loop support-policy diagnostic data for the 72-spec scenario task family
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic feasibility/support evidence only; no ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if support policies are interpreted as controller candidates
stop if the runner loses scenario metadata or support labels
stop if ranking_admissible or winner_selected becomes true
stop if implementation cannot preserve 1080-episode denominator
fallback_plan: route to implementation repair if schema/metadata fail
route to result audit if execution artifact is complete
route to scenario spec redesign if support execution exposes unsupported tasks
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2312 admits support-policy feasibility calibration implementation

admission_evidence: M2312 freezes support policies aeb aes envelope_aes
M2312 forbids controller ranking and paper/self-ID claims
allowed_updates: M2313 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the result
next_stage_criteria: 1080 episode rows are produced or fail-closed with failure rows
summary and support labels are written

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2313 uses support policies as diagnostic feasibility bounds and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2313; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: 72-spec current-sim scenario task-family support-policy diagnostic panel.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If support policies fail broadly, route to scenario feasibility/metric audit instead of weakening self-ID criteria.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds new support-policy diagnostic data rather than repairing the same checkpoint family
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can classify the task pack as support-clear support-mixed support-blocked or metric-conflicted before ranking
must_synthesize_if: support-policy diagnostics are used to rank controllers
the next proposed task is another scalar reward tweak
the feasibility branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A support-policy diagnostic panel can separate scenario feasibility/support from actor weakness without ranking controllers.
success_criteria: summary.json exists in the M2313 output directory
a follow-up result-audit manifest is selected
failure_criteria: M2313 starts training replay PPO private holdout or promotion
M2313 ranks support policies or selects a winner
M2313 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2313 omits support labels or role support aggregates
M2313 cannot preserve the 1080-episode denominator without fail-closed artifacts

commands.name: execute
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_feasibility_calibration --config configs/paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_v0.json --output-dir runs/m2313_paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_feasibility_calibration --eval-seed-base 231300 --support-policies aeb aes envelope_aes --seed-repeats 5 --target-scenario-spec-count 72 --target-support-policy-count 3 --target-episode-count 1080 --next-blocker m2314-paper-route-current-sim-scenario-task-family-feasibility-calibration-result-audit

decision_rule: M2313 passes if it implements the diagnostic runner, writes complete support-policy artifacts, and pre-registers a result audit without ranking.
